what: Promo card (banner) stuck to a screen corner — hovering the card scales it to 1.04 in .4s ease, and hovering the × close above it rotates 180° in .3s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1). Pressing close hides the close at once, the card height collapses to 0 in .3s, then it is removed (the closing of the Studio toggle sd-toggle). The entrance applies the up type of studio-appear on the same element together

options.fold: Length (sec) for cards to fold, default .3 — 0 makes them vanish instantly
options.--fx-scale: Card interaction response scale (css variable), default 1.04
options.--fx-dur-hover: Card interaction response duration (CSS variable), default .4s
options.--fx-ease-hover: Card interaction response curve (css variable), default ease
options.--fx-dur-back: How long the card takes to return after the hover ends (css variable), default .3s — the original sets .4s ease only on :hover, so the return uses the normal transition
options.--fx-spin: Rotation on close-hand reaction (css variable), default 180deg
options.--fx-close-dur: Close rotation length (CSS variable), default .3s — named separately so it doesn’t mix with studio-appear’s --fx-dur when both apply to one element
options.--fx-close-ease: Close rotation·fold curve (css variable), default cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1)
options.[data-fx-part=close]: Close button (button) — fires an fx:close event on click. On click the element gets is-closed, and when fully folded is-gone (the moment the user collapses the panel width — in the original only the 24px close button width remains)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card that folds away (link/image) — its height folds down to 0

note: The user decides the position (fixed, corner), card corners and shadow (var(--kf-shadow-soft)). The original has no way to reopen after closing — because the close button is also the toggle handle and it hides along with the card
